appearance_facts.fact: x-axis is labeled 'Year' and includes tick marks for 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018.

Industry data is represented by a red dashed line with square markers.

The 2014 Industry data point is a red square located at the 2014 tick mark on the x-axis, with a y-value of approximately 26.62%.
